# Press Release For Business

> A newswire publishing company announcements at permanent canonical addresses with explicit
> publication dates, named issuing organizations, named spokespeople and structured markup.
> Every release is permanently labelled as an announcement issued by the named organization
> rather than as reporting by this publication. Operated by Eye To Ad Media, Denver, Colorado.

## How to read this wire

Each document here is a **press release** — a statement issued by the organization named as its
source, published by us. It is not independent reporting and is labelled as such at the top of
every page. Factual responsibility rests with the issuing organization, which is why every
release carries attribution.

Outbound links inside paid announcements carry sponsored attributes. This service does not sell
following links and does not represent itself as a link-building product.

## Publishing tiers and prices

All prices are one-time, per release, in USD. There is no subscription and no contract.
Payment is taken after the customer approves the final document. Declined announcements are
refunded in full. Word limit is 1,400 at every tier.

- **Standard — $19.99**: published as written at a permanent canonical URL, explicit publication
  date, named issuing organization, permanent announcement label, RSS syndication, share tools
  and print formatting.
- **Optimized — $49.99**: everything in Standard, plus (1) the opening passage rewritten to be
  accurate and complete in isolation, (2) unverifiable claims converted into checkable facts or
  removed, (3) an at-a-glance summary block marked as the document abstract, (4) a frequently-asked
  section published with FAQPage markup, (5) sameAs entity identity linking connecting the release
  to the issuer's verified profiles, (6) explicit subject declaration via the about property,
  (7) speakable passage marking for voice assistants, (8) listing in this file with a written
  description. Includes one revision round.
- **Network — $99**: everything in Optimized, plus editorial pickup on Action Global News and
  placement on up to two relevance-matched network properties, each labelled and canonically
  linked back to the original. Priority review and two revision rounds.

Outbound links inside paid announcements carry rel="sponsored nofollow" at every tier. This is
not a link-building service and no following links are sold at any price. Entity linking via
sameAs is a structured-data assertion about identity, not a hyperlink.

## Releases

- [Advertising For Contractors Warns Trades Businesses to Prepare Now as Google Folds Local Services Ads Into Google Ads](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/advertising-for-contractors-google-lsa-migration/): Advertising For Contractors is advising trades businesses to prepare for Google's migration of Local Services Ads into Google Ads via pay-per-lead Performance Max campaigns, which began for US advertisers in August 2026 and removes the standalone LSA dashboard and manual cost-per-lead controls. Issued by Advertising For Contractors (https://advertisingforcontractors.com), dated 2026-09-25, Denver, Colorado.
- [Aging Safely Baths Highlights Bathroom Accessibility Planning as Households Reconsider Aging-in-Place Renovations](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/aging-safely-baths-walk-in-tub-accessibility/): Aging Safely Baths, a nationwide walk-in tub and barrier-free shower supplier operating since 2012, has published planning guidance for households considering bathroom accessibility renovations ahead of need rather than in response to an injury. Issued by Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com), dated 2026-09-25, Denver, Colorado.
- [Elevation Health Pairs Registered-Dietitian Support With Physician-Prescribed GLP-1 Care as Research Highlights an Industry-Wide Support Gap](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/elevation-health-dietitian-led-glp1-support/): Elevation Health structures its telehealth GLP-1 program around registered-dietitian support alongside physician prescribing, in response to published 2026 research identifying high discontinuation rates and limited nutritional oversight across the telehealth weight-management sector. Issued by Elevation Health (https://loseweightonglp1.com), dated 2026-09-25, Denver, Colorado.
- [Eye To Ad Media Expands Generative Engine Optimization Practice as AI Assistants Reshape How Customers Find Local Businesses](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/eye-to-ad-media-generative-engine-optimization/): Eye To Ad Media has expanded its generative engine optimization practice, formalizing a service line focused on entity consistency, structured data and machine-readable publishing for businesses that need to appear in AI-generated answers. Issued by Eye To Ad Media (https://www.eyetoad.com), dated 2026-09-25, Denver, Colorado.
- [Roof Solutions Urges Metro Atlanta Homeowners to Photograph Roofs Before Storm Season as Georgia Insurance Rules Shift in 2026](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/roof-solutions-photo-documentation-atlanta-insurance/): Roof Solutions is advising Metro Atlanta homeowners to establish photographic documentation of roof condition ahead of storm season, citing 2026 changes to Georgia insurance legislation, a City of Atlanta cool roof ordinance and increased carrier scrutiny of roofs over 15 years old. Issued by Roof Solutions (https://bestroofersatlanta.com), dated 2026-09-25, Atlanta, Georgia.
- [World VR Mall Opens Browser-Based Virtual Shopping Concourse With Merchant Storefronts Linking to Live Ecommerce Sites](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/world-vr-mall-launch/): World VR Mall has launched a browser-based three-dimensional shopping concourse where visitors walk a central walkway and enter merchant storefronts that link through to those merchants' own ecommerce sites. No headset or download is required. Issued by World VR Mall (https://www.worldvrmall.com), dated 2026-09-25, Denver, Colorado.
- [A Nu Do Salon Expands Virtual Consultations as Industry Data Shows Roughly Half of Salon Bookings Happen After Hours](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/a-nu-do-salon-virtual-consultation-after-hours-booking/): A Nu Do Salon has expanded its virtual consultation service alongside online booking, citing 2026 industry benchmarks placing after-hours booking demand at 46% to 50% of all salon appointments and identifying in-depth consultation as a defining shift in salon service. Issued by A Nu Do Salon (https://anudosalon.com), dated 2026-09-24, Brighton, Colorado.
- [Bighorn Painting Flags Closing Exterior Painting Window as Colorado Overnight Temperatures Approach the Coating Threshold](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/bighorn-painting-colorado-exterior-season-window/): Bighorn Painting is advising Front Range homeowners that the Colorado exterior painting season is closing, as most exterior coatings fail to bond below 50°F and overnight lows approach that threshold. The Arvada contractor has outlined what can still be completed and what should wait. Issued by Bighorn Painting (https://www.bighornpainting.com), dated 2026-09-24, Arvada, Colorado.
- [Showers4Less Outlines Specification Differences Between Barrier-Free Shower Kits as Demand for Accessible Bathing Grows](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/showers4less-barrier-free-shower-kits/): Showers4Less has published specification comparison guidance for barrier-free shower kits, covering pan construction, threshold height, wall system compatibility and the subfloor requirements that determine feasibility of a zero-entry installation. Issued by Showers4Less (https://www.showers4less.com), dated 2026-09-24, Denver, Colorado.
- [VR Flying Simulator Launches Browser-Based Procedural Trainer Aimed at Student Pilots Between Lessons](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/vr-flying-simulator-launch/): VR Flying Simulator has launched a browser-based procedural trainer for student pilots covering checklist discipline, instrument scan and navigation tracking. The company states explicitly that it is not an approved training device and logs no hours toward any certificate. Issued by VR Flying Simulator (https://www.vrflyingsimulator.com), dated 2026-09-24, Denver, Colorado.
- [Rustic Barnwood Furniture Details Custom Commission Process as Reclaimed Material Supply Shapes What Can Be Built](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/rustic-barnwood-furniture-custom-commission-process/): Rustic Barnwood Furniture has detailed its custom commission process for reclaimed barnwood pieces built in Colorado, explaining how the characteristics of salvaged material determine dimensions, finish and lead time on made-to-order work. Issued by Rustic Barnwood Furniture (https://rusticbarnwoodfurniture.com), dated 2026-09-23, Colorado.
- [Search Converts Details Membership Structure for Small Business Growth Program Built Around Strategy Sessions and Community Distribution](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/releases/search-converts-membership-growth-program/): Search Converts has detailed the structure of its business growth accelerator, a membership program combining strategy sessions, campaign testing and distribution through community networks, positioned as an alternative to conventional advertising retainers. Issued by Search Converts (https://www.searchconverts.com), dated 2026-09-23, Denver, Colorado.

## Pages

- [Pricing](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/pricing/): Tier comparison, what each includes, refund terms.
- [Submit a release](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/submit/): Submission form and the review process. Nothing is charged
  at submission; payment follows approval of the final document.
- [Press release optimization explained](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/optimization/): The eight items of work in
  an Optimized release, itemized with what each does. Covers sameAs entity linking in full —
  what it is, why it is not a hyperlink, and the condition under which it helps. Also states
  plainly what optimization can reliably do, what it plausibly does, and what it cannot do
  (no links, no ranking promise, no guaranteed AI citation).
- [How it works](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/how-it-works/): What is changed in an announcement before publication —
  opening passage, claim tightening, named spokesperson, explicit dates, structured markup,
  canonical URL.
- [Editorial guidelines](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/guidelines/): What is accepted, what is declined categorically,
  what is sent back for revision, labelling, links, corrections and removal.
- [About](https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/about/): Why this exists, who operates it, and the network relationship.
